name: broadside
description: Top-down 3D pirate ship battles in the browser

scripts.build: npm run test && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && vite build
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:ios && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:sim: npm run ios:sync && cap run ios --no-sync
scripts.ios:build:sim: npm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -packageAuthorizationProvider netrc CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:public: npm run test && tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode public
